question: Can ritual performance occur apart from the Bhairavī and Tattva circles?
premises: Performance is prescribed as a possible action
The Bhairavī circle is excluded as a condition
The Tattva circle is excluded as a condition
inference: Ritual performance may be undertaken without the Bhairavī and Tattva circles
